## About
BMWerks is a repair shop on Dickinson Ave in Dickinson, Texas. If you need service on your BMW or other luxury import, we're open and happy to hear from you.
Customers know Carlin by name. One longtime customer called him "the most honest and helpful BMW specialist that you could ever imagine," and a second said he's "Helpful, Honest, Straight Forward and the Prices are Fair."
We're rated 4.7 from 29 Google reviews, and a lot of what people write about is straight answers and fair prices compared to the dealer.

## Services
- Service on your BMW or other luxury import: Repair and maintenance for your BMW or other luxury import.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on BMW cars?
A: BMW is our focus, and we also work on other luxury imports. One customer had work done on both a BMW and a Mercedes Benz.

Q: How do I get my car in?
A: Give us a call to set up an appointment. One customer called first, dropped the car off, and had it ready the next day.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
